description: Inherited-context fixture for C1-T6 chunk extraction. The explicit regnal year 建安十三年 appears in the opening chunk only; later chunks must inherit it verbatim (scope inherited, inherited_fields set) with the document-verified normalized year 208 and no invented month/day precision. Pronouns 其/公 in later chunks refer to surfaces (曹操/劉琮/周瑜) introduced earlier. Every Claim evidence must be an exact substring of its own chunk.
